summary.uncertainty_note: u_db is repeatability only (sweep-to-sweep, reconnection, repeated inserts). Analyzer linearity (vendor: about +/-3 dB at constant RBW) is checked with fixed attenuators of known tolerance (minus_nominal_db) and by direct vs att30; absolute accuracy of both handheld instruments is reported separately

ipex_pigtail_plus_adapter.note: ipex_pigtail_chain minus coupler_thru_pigtail_setup. Upper bound on pigtail+adapter from one mating. Do not subtract ipex_adapter_direct. A negative value is not a loss and must not be chained.
